notes.title: GUN MODS + MODDING GUNS UPDATE (AGAIN)
notes.content:
Modding changes

 Guns now have attachments/ mods.
 Enemies can now spawn with guns that have attachments/ mods.
 Optimized in game mod loading.



CAEDES changes

 Increased performance via texture optimization.
 Decreased download size via texture optimization.
 Fixed file size glitch resulting from a file being over 4GB.
 Guns now have attachments and mods!
 Reworked all levels to incorporate modded guns.
 Fixed blood not spawning a lot of the time.
 Fixed flashlights causing vision to go black.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Modding changes

 Added new "Gangster" enemy model
 Added new "Assault" enemy model



CAEDES changes

 Changed "Festival of Lights" and "Subway - Drindge's Demise" to use the new "Gangster" enemy model
 Changed library to use the new "Assault" enemy model
 Reworked syncing for Library AI and Warehouse AI
 Reworked syncing of ids a lot - hopefully this will result in better overall sync
 Improved performance of all enemy 3D models
 Re-baked lighting for tutorial levels and shooting range
 Library level fixed a coop glitch where the phone wasn't "receiving" files for second player
 Updated "Frindge" to "Drindge" D'oh

notes.title: Modding Expansion
notes.content:
Modding changes

 Added breakable objects to level editor
 Added non-digetic noise to level editor
 Added footstep volume to level editor
 Added impact volume to level editor
 Added custom multiplayer sync script for custom object in level editor
 Added an example Water object to level editor
 Added a damage trigger object to level editor




CAEDES changes

 Added a bit more blood to large caliber guns
 Added launch options: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2551674526

notes.title: CAEDES MODDING RELEASED
notes.content:
INTRODUCING THE SteamWorkshop! Download and Upload mods for CAEDES
 Modding tools + tutorial to get started: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2550091111
 New level select!
 Fixed screen going black over dead bodies some times.
 Increased mag drop rate for mp7, mac10, makarov.
 Fixed two multiplayer bugs that would cause a crash.
Fixed bug in library level where all music would play at the same time

notes.title: AI PROCEDURAL DEATHS UPDATE
notes.content:
New procedural AI death animations (try shooting them in the nuts)
 After dying AI limbs can be "disabled" by repeat shootings
 Added small dead-zone to movement controls
 Attempted to fix Quest controls
 Movement speed slightly adjusted 
 If host is dead and second player disconnects host can now leave the level (whoops)

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER UPDATE
notes.content:
Added a new scenario where the timeout should be 999 seconds.
 Dying now causes you to drop weapons.
 Dying now causes you to become a ghost.
 First player to die in coop can now roam the map as a ghost.

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER TIMEOUT UPDATE
notes.content:
Turns out there was a hidden timeout that was internal and I didn't know
 Set default timeout to 20 seconds
 Set timeout to 999 seconds if server is changing levels. This means both players have to load the level within 999 seconds.
 AI update in groups now - might help with disconnect issue we'll see what happens and if I keep this long term.

notes.title: LEVEL LOADING UPDATE
notes.content:
Reworked how levels load - hopefully helps with multiplayer disconnects + crashes
 Ear piece audio/ narration no longer affected by level reverb settings
 Subway level had floating tshirts riding the subway - turned them back into people

notes.title: RECOIL UPDATE + NEW STUFF
notes.content:
Recoil has been reduced for the following guns:

 Mac-10
 UMP
 AK
 MP5
 PX4 Storm
 Ruger MKIII
 Glock 22


NEW LEVEL! Fight back against an evil terrorist cell that has captured the local police station.

NEW GUNS:

 MP7
 Makarov


Patches:

 Fixed flicker issue in Festival of Lights
 Possible scaling/ Culling issue fix for the Camera
 Slow-mo color grading fixed - you can now still see in dark areas
 Festival of Lights - Colt 1911 replaced with Makarovs
 Increased chromatic aberration during slow mo
 Tried to optimize every texture in the game
 New terrorist npc
 ADDED survivor npc variant and terrorist variant to NPC gun in shooting range

notes.title: Fixes + New NPC + New Level
notes.content:
New level called "Bosnian Winter" - I'm not entirely happy with it so I might remove it later but for now it show cases the new bolt action sniper and the new NPC skin
 Revamped AI skin randomization
 Increased Steam Time Out in CO-OP
 Added unique reverb to every level - gun shots should have nice reverb according to the environment

notes.title: CO-OP HOTFIX
notes.content:
Secret new feature was causing a bug in multiplayer - sorry.
 Bolt action behaves better,
 Co-op mode had an unknown bug where the other player would let go of an object but it would still be ungrabbable by you.

notes.title: BOLT ACTION GUN + SCOPES + PUMP SHOTGUN
notes.content:
Reintroduced pump action shotgun
 Added a bolt action rifle to the range
 Added framework for realistic scopes (try it out on the bolt action rifle in the range)
 Shooting range is no longer at an angle.

notes.title: AI GUN PROFILE UPDATE
notes.content:
Guns now have a unique "profile" that AI will use to figure out how the gun should be utilized.
 Fixed AI killing itself when reloading - whoops.
 Networking solution update - old versions are incompatible with new versions. Update your games!

notes.title: SMALL AI UPDATE
notes.content:
AI can use shotguns now/ guns requiring multiple bullet/ shell inserts to reload.
 Added a pistol to the range to spawn AI for fun

notes.title: CO-OP OVERHAUL
notes.content:
Full CO-OP Stability overhaul - CO-OP is now synchronized significantly better and de-sync should occur way less.
 Better gun sync.
 Better event sync.
 Better AI sync.
 Low health no longer dims the screen but tints the edges red.

notes.title: CO-OP HOT FIX
notes.content:
Other player's body is more reliable now on loading a level - should decrease the chance of this happening: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8yfNOSNPTzc&feature=youtu.be&t=18s
Player join sound and player leave sound added
Fixed Mac-10 grip being funky
Wounds no longer persist after respawning

notes.title: CO-OP MODE RELEASED
notes.content:
That's right - there's a brand new CO-OP feature in Caedes! Take on any level, even the tutorial, together with a friend! Also a new level has been released "Festival of Lights" - it's very challenging so I suggest taking it head on with a friend!

How to play with a friend

 Insert the blue floppy disk
 Invite your friend (they must already be in game)
 Play Co-op!


REMEMBER TO REPORT ANY BUGS!

notes.title: WORKING ON A BIG UPDATE
notes.content: Hey guys, sorry it's taking me so long. I'm working on a big update and I'm really trying to get this out the door but I have to both create a bunch of new systems as well as rewrite some old ones and it's taking much longer than expected. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: UPDATE 3
notes.content:
Removed extra pistol from tutorial - whoops how'd that get there.
 New grab system for unimportant props - hands will auto conform to the shape of the object (not as accurate as manual posing which will stay for important props such as guns and other interact-ables)

notes.title: UPDATE 2
notes.content:
Grabbing code is now much more reliable for both player and AI
 AI can now aim rifles and SMGs much better
 New method for detecting VR controllers which should fix an issue where VR HMD didn't match the controllers caused the game to be unplayable
 Tutorial now completely unskippable*

notes.title: FIRST UPDATE
notes.content:
Updated the calibration scene to be more visually fun/ pleasing.
 Extended the zone where the magazine can be put into the gun manually for pistols.
 Options menu now part of the tutorial.
 Index will now default to SQUEEZE rather than TRIGGER grip style.
